timeline.summary: Supreme Industries Ltd will host a conference call for analysts and investors on April 27, 2026, at 16:00 IST, led by Chairman & Managing Director M. P. Taparia, CFO P. C. Somani, and VP (Corporate Affairs) & Company Secretary R. J. Saboo.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹3,527.66 Cr (+16.5% YoY), net profit ₹433.57 Cr (+47.5% YoY).
Supreme Industries reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹3,527.66 Cr and net profit of ₹433.57 Cr, recommended a ₹25 final dividend, and announced a ₹1,000+ Cr capex plan for FY27.
Supreme Industries released its March 2026 investor presentation, reporting FY26 revenue of ₹11,217.67 Cr and outlining a ₹1,000 Cr capex plan for FY27.
Supreme Industries Limited shared the audio recording link for its conference call on Q4FY26 results held on 27th April 2026 at 4:00 PM.
Supreme Industries hosted its Q4FY26 earnings conference call on April 27, 2026, reporting FY26 revenue of ₹11,218 Cr and a ₹1,000 Cr capex plan.
Mahaveerprasad Surajmal Taparia declared no encumbrance on Supreme Industries shares for FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
On 28 July 2026, Supreme Industries held its Q1FY27 earnings call, reporting 14% volume decline but maintaining FY27 guidance of 15-17% piping volume growth and 14-14.5% EBITDA margin.
DAM Capital hosted Supreme Industries’ Q2FY27 earnings call on 26 Oct 2026 at 16:00 IST, featuring Chairman & MD M. P. Taparia, CFO P. C. Somani, and VP (Corporate Affairs) R. J. Saboo.

watchlist.text: Analysts repeatedly asked whether Q1 margin gain included inventory gains and to quantify them.

watchlist.text: Analysts pressed on why FY27 margin guidance of 14-14.5% is lower than FY26's 14.5-15.5% despite Q1 margin of 14.64%.

watchlist.response: Management said 'No idea, no idea' and that import data is not easily available.
